topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic establishes the lecture's learning objectives, contextualizes them within previous lectures, and introduces Hanahan and Weinberg's cancer hallmarks model.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Growth Factor Independence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the signaling pathways and upstream receptor mutations that drive autonomous cancer cell proliferation and survival, focusing on Wnt, RTK/MAPK, and PI3K signaling.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Malignancies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how failure of progenitor and epithelial cells to terminally differentiate promotes malignant expansion in leukemias and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Resistance to Programmed Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells evade apoptosis through the deregulation of p53 and the disruption of the mitochondrial Bax and BCL2 balance.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells achieve indefinite replication through telomerase reactivation and the circumvention of p53-mediated senescence and stress signaling.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics transition to complex physiological hallmarks and examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolic pathways via aerobic glycolysis, Krebs cycle mutations, and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the angiogenic switch required for supplying oxygen and nutrients to growing tumors, detailing its timing, regulatory balance, and therapeutic implications.

topics.label: Invasion, Circulation, and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the multi-step metastatic cascade, covering vascular dissemination, lymphatic detection, circulating tumor cell monitoring, and the genetic and microenvironmental factors governing secondary site colonization.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding synthesis of cancer hallmarks, offers recommended reading, and handles closing logistical remarks for students.
